tasks.task: Write a Python function that parses an AWS S3 bucket name from a full S3 ARN string like 'arn:aws:s3:::my-bucket/path/to/object' and returns just the bucket name.
Create a JSON object representing an AWS IAM policy that grants read-only access to all objects in an S3 bucket named 'data-lake'.
Write a Regex pattern that validates AWS EC2 instance IDs, which follow the format 'i-' followed by 8 or 17 hexadecimal characters (e.g., 'i-0abcd1234efgh5678').
